label: Prediction and repair
title: Which distinctions are needed to predict and to repair?
summary: On a fixed Rule-54 ring and one-injury task, a two-label parity view predicts passive persistence, while repair requires four labels recording adjacent differences. The minimum repair view still merges complementary sources.
takeaway: Task sufficiency need not preserve a previous sensor's labels. But this target admits no passive return from outside, so its delayed repair task reduces to static error correction; autonomous recovery and purpose remain untested.
